note: 제작진 모드(B2)가 분야별로 고르는 선택 메뉴와 전문가 규칙. 우리가 직접 쓴 문장이며 외부 사전을 복사하지 않았다(GPL 원본 DENO 와 분리). 값은 전문가가 고치고 version 을 올린다.
global_rules: Keep every subject, object, action, count and color the user gave.
Use positive phrasing only; never use no, not, without, avoid or never.
Do not mention text, letters, logos, brand names or captions anywhere, and do not put any person in the picture unless the request names one.
If the request names a purpose (poster, banner, thumbnail, ad), the purpose decides composition and brightness, and no menu choice may contradict it.
Choose time of day and weather only when the request names them; otherwise pick the one that fits the purpose.

purpose_words.포스터: poster: bright clear colors, one strong focal element, a clean horizon or axis, open empty space where a title could go (but no text)
purpose_words.썸네일: thumbnail: a large simple subject, high contrast, readable at a small size
purpose_words.배너: banner: wide composition with the subject on one side and open space on the other
purpose_words.광고: advertisement: the subject is the hero, polished lighting, clean uncluttered surroundings
purpose_words.홍보: promotion: inviting, bright, clearly shows the place or product being promoted
purpose_words.표지: cover: one centered or third-aligned subject with generous margin
